services.name: 3 Hour Private Custom Charter
services.desc: Experience The Magic Of Kauai's Waters, Tailored To You About At Po'ipu Offshore Adventures, we offer private charter experiences for up to 6 guests, allowing flexibility to tailor your custom offshore adventure. Specializing in south shore snorkeling and sightseeing, as well as seasonal whale watching (December-March) our 3 hour charters run three times a day for convenience and efficiency. We strive to provide the ultimate offshore experience and share the magic of Kauai's waters with our guests. We are looking forward to meeting you. What's Included: Top of the line equipment and Whether it’s Snorkeling, Sightseeing, Whale Watching, we can tailor the trip for you • Ages 5 & Up

services.name: Sunset Whalewatch
services.desc: Experience A Marvelous Kaua'i Sunset! Tour Time & Daily Our Sunset Special is from 3:45pm-6:45pm and allows a great opportunity to encounter wildlife and enjoy an amazing South Shore sunset and afterglow. About Experience the beauty of Kauai's landscape at dusk on our private sunset sightseeing tour. Our sunset tour offers guests the opportunity to marvel at the beautiful south shore and mountain ranges during golden hour, catching an amazing sunset on the water and even getting lucky with a chance to witness the famous “green flash”. What's Included: Fresh pineapple, tropical Experience the beauty of Kauai’s land & ocean scape during golden hour • Ages 5 & Up

services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: Let's make this fishing adventure the highlight of your vacation! Tour Time & 4, 6 and 8 hour charter options 6:30am departure About Come out with us to target some of the most desirable game fish in the world. From offshore species, such as ahi, ono, mahi mahi and marlin, to the brutes of the reef such as the giant trevally, great amberjack, barracuda and more. Our vessel’s versatility allows us to mix it up to get you in on the action. 4 Hour Charter: Our 4 hour charter allows you to get a taste of offshore fishing without spending the whole day on the water. 6 Hour Charter: Our 6 4, 6 or 8 Hours • Customized to You • Up to 6 Guests • Ages 5 & Up

services.desc: Tour Time & 6 and 8 hour charter options 7:30 departure 6 Hour - Fish, Snorkel, Cruise Try your luck at offshore fishing while we cruise over to the snorkel grounds where you can cool off and marvel at Kauai's diverse fish, turtles and marine life. 8 Hour - Fish, Snorkel Our 8 hour Fish/ snorkel A full day adventure with ample to fish snorkel and explore Kauai’s amazing ocean environment What's Included: Top of the line equipment and instruction Dry bag to keep your belongings dry Hawaiian juices, filtered water, snacks, and fresh local fruits Gratuity is not included in your 6 or 8 Hours • Customized to You • Up to 6 Guests • Ages 5 & Up

services.name: Napali Coast Adventure *April-September
services.desc: Tour Time & 8 hour charter 7:00 departure Looking for a true offshore adventure? Cruise along the forgotten south shore en route to the majestic Napali Coast. On this tour we’re bound to find the playful Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins as they frolic in the calm west side waters. Once on the Napali Coast, we’ll explore the towering sea cliffs, lush and sheer valleys and canyons, zip into sea caves and snorkel at the base of a soaring cliffside while looking for the resident sea turtles and endangered monk seals. What's Included: Top of the line equipment and instruction Dry bag to Cruise and explore the towering cliffs, beaches and sea caves of the Napali coast.
